_curationNote: Represents the LCL repository as a whole (Jira NFOSI-1355 / Synapse syn74552629). The specific named/coded LCL lines are listed in a private inventory spreadsheet (MTA-restricted, not accessible for review here). Once someone with access can share the individual line names, consider whether they should be split out into per-line submissions/cell_lines/*.json entries instead of one biobank record.

basicInfo.biobankName: MGH NF1 Lymphoblastoid Cell Line Repository
basicInfo.description: Human lymphoblastoid cell lines derived from the blood of individuals with NF1 via EBV transformation, maintained by James Walker's group at Massachusetts General Hospital as part of a Gilbert Family Foundation Gene Therapy Initiative project (Optimization of Base and Prime Editing Strategies for NF1 Therapeutics).
basicInfo.contact: Contact NF-OSI (nf-osi@sagebionetworks.org) to be connected with the MGH team; a Material Transfer Agreement is required.
